course.title: Unit 3 Where did you go?-Part B--【例句】
course.description: Part B（How did you go there? What did you do?）

sentences.content: Where did you go over the winter holiday? My family and I went to Sanya.
sentences.english: Where did you go over the winter holiday ? My family and I went to Sanya
sentences.chinese: 寒假期间你去哪里了？我和家人去了三亚。

wordDetails.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

sentences.content: How did you go there? We went there by plane.
sentences.english: How did you go there ? We went there by plane
sentences.chinese: 你们是怎么去那儿的？我们是坐飞机去的。

wordDetails.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

sentences.content: How was the beach? It was beautiful.
sentences.english: How was the beach ? It was beautiful

sentences.content: What did you do there? I took lots of pictures and went swimming.
sentences.english: What did you do there ? I took lots of pictures and went swimming
sentences.chinese: 你在那里做了什么？我拍了很多照片，还去游泳了。

wordDetails.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

sentences.content: Can I see your pictures sometime? Sure.
sentences.english: Can I see your pictures sometime ? Sure
sentences.chinese: 改天能看看你的照片吗？当然可以。

sentences.content: Last summer holiday, Andy ate fresh food and took pictures.
sentences.english: Last summer holiday , Andy ate fresh food and took pictures
sentences.chinese: 去年暑假，Andy享用了新鲜美食并拍摄了照片。

sentences.content: He bought some gifts for his friends.
sentences.english: He bought some gifts for his friends
sentences.chinese: 他给朋友们买了一些礼物。

sentences.content: We rode a bike for three people. Max sat in a basket on the front.
sentences.english: We rode a bike for three people . Max sat in a basket on the front
sentences.chinese: 我们骑了一辆三人自行车。Max坐在前面的车篮里。

sentences.content: We took pictures of the beautiful countryside.
sentences.english: We took pictures of the beautiful countryside
sentences.chinese: 我们拍摄了美丽的乡村风光。

sentences.content: Mum ate some bad fruit and didn’t feel well. So we stayed in the hotel.
sentences.english: Mum ate some bad fruit and didn't feel well . So we stayed in the hotel
sentences.chinese: 妈妈吃了些变质的水果，感觉不太舒服。所以我们待在酒店里。
